THE SHORT ANSWER

Choose the app that passes your real booking workflow on the plan you can afford. Start with availability, payment and customer self-service, then compare price.

Which Shopify booking app should you choose?

A solo consultant, a busy salon and a rental operator do not need the same booking system. The right app should let a customer choose a service, select a genuinely available time, pay the right amount and receive useful instructions. It should also make the next change—an instructor's holiday, a cancellation or a reschedule—easy to handle.

Our shortlist below covers distinct buying situations. It is an editorial selection by the team behind Cowlendar, not an independent ranking or a claim that we installed and tested every app. Prices are monthly USD from the linked official listings, checked September 22, 2026.

Compare the price of the workflow, not the entry plan

Cowlendar starts at $13.99 per month after its five-booking free allowance, with paid tiers based on booking revenue. Apntly's paid plans start at $5, while its Pro plan lists groups, calendar integrations and deposits at $9. Those are different pricing models, so neither headline price tells the whole story.

Appointo lists paid subscriptions from $14 and discloses a 2% charge for subscriptions/bundles. BookX distinguishes basic Google Calendar integration from two-way synchronization on its Business tier. Easy Appointment Booking lists some staff logins and advanced integrations separately. These details can change the comparison more than a small difference in the starting price.

Build a simple budget with your number of services, staff accounts, locations, expected monthly bookings and average booking value. Add messaging costs, required integrations and any transaction-linked charges. Then ask each vendor to confirm the exact plan that supports that scenario.

Five checks that reveal whether an app fits

  1. Availability: create a busy event outside Shopify and confirm the corresponding slot is unavailable. Check whether the connection imports conflicts or only exports appointments.
  2. Capacity: book the last remaining seat or resource, then try the same time from another browser. A product quantity and a time-slot capacity are different constraints.
  3. Payments: place a test order using the intended payment method. Check the deposit, balance due, order record and refund behavior separately.
  4. Changes: use the customer-facing reschedule and cancellation links. Confirm that reminders and external calendar events reflect the change.
  5. Mobile: complete the booking on a small screen, including a longer service name, timezone selection and checkout.

When Cowlendar is a sensible fit

Cowlendar is designed for merchants who want appointments, groups, rentals and related booking features in one Shopify workflow. Its public listing puts the feature set across its plans; the free allowance and paid booking-revenue ceilings remain important limits. If you only need unlimited bookings for one simple service, another app's free plan may be a better financial fit.

Use the feature catalogue to identify the required behavior, then compare the appropriate pricing tier. If you need a specialized property-management system, medical records platform or complex route optimization, do not assume a booking widget replaces it.

Make the trial count

Write down three bookings that represent your business: the ordinary one, the awkward one and the one that previously caused a support ticket. Recreate all three before changing the live storefront. Include existing future appointments in the migration plan and keep the old calendar available until counts and times match.

Common questions

Does Shopify include appointment scheduling?

Shopify supports selling services, but service availability and appointment scheduling usually require a booking app. Shopify’s service-selling documentation points merchants to suitable apps.

Which booking app is cheapest?

It depends on the full workflow. Some apps have ongoing free plans; compare service limits, reminders, calendar sync, deposits and staff access before deciding.
